title: India seeks tariff advantage before implementing U.S. trade deal
title_zh: 印度在实施美国贸易协议之前寻求关税优势
summary: Investing.com -- India is seeking lower tariff rates than competing nations before moving ahead with a long-awaited trade agreement with the United States, Bloomberg reported, citing comments from Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal.
summary_zh: Investing.com——彭博社援引商业和工业部长皮尤什·戈亚尔的评论报道称，印度正在寻求比竞争国家更低的关税，然后再与美国达成期待已久的贸易协议。

title: Long Corporate Bond ETFs: IGLB Offers Broad Exposure While VCLT Is Slightly Cheaper
title_zh: 多头公司债券 ETF：IGLB 提供广泛的投资机会，而 VCLT 稍便宜
summary: The iShares 10+ Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF (IGLB) and the Vanguard Long-Term Corporate Bond ETF (VCLT) both target long-maturity corporate debt.
summary_zh: iShares 10+ 年投资级企业债券 ETF (IGLB) 和 Vanguard 长期企业债券 ETF (VCLT) 均针对长期企业债务。

title: When You Play Defense With Consumer Staples, Which ETF Should You Own? Funds From State Street and First Trust Offer a Stark Choice.
title_zh: 当您防御必需消费品时，您应该持有哪只 ETF？道富银行和第一信托基金提供了一个严峻的选择。
summary: Compare portfolio strategies and sector exposures as two leading consumer staples ETFs take different paths to long-term returns.
summary_zh: 比较投资组合策略和行业风险敞口，因为两个领先的消费必需品 ETF 采用不同的长期回报路径。

title: Peter Thiel’s secret society talks AI takeover, World War III and ‘cult-building’ — a hacker just revealed who’s in it
title_zh: 彼得·泰尔的秘密社团谈论人工智能接管、第三次世界大战和“邪教建设”——一名黑客刚刚透露了其中的成员
summary: Billionaires, CEOs, generals and senators all attend Dialogue events. Here’s what they worry about behind closed doors.
summary_zh: 亿万富翁、首席执行官、将军和参议员都参加对话活动。这是他们私下担心的事情。

title: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT): One of the Best Falling Stocks Despite Getting Out of Oracle Data Center Deal
title_zh: 微软公司（MSFT）：尽管退出了甲骨文数据中心交易，但仍是跌幅最大的股票之一
summary: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is one of the best falling stocks to invest in, according to analysts. On June 17, Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) stock edged lower amid reports it had abandoned plans to lease an Oracle Data center.
summary_zh: 分析师表示，微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）是最值得投资的下跌股票之一。 6 月 17 日，微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）股价小幅走低，有报道称该公司已放弃租赁甲骨文数据中心的计划。
